text: Hello everyone, welcome to our English class.Nice to see you again.Do you often think about what you will be in the future?Will you be a brave policeman, a famous reporter, or a hard-working teacher?Well, today you are going to learn something special about the topic.Before we start our lesson, please check if you have these things, your student's book, your notebook, worksheet, and pens.请准备好你的课本,笔记本,学习单,和笔。Are you ready?OK, now let's start.What a nice picture!Boys and girls, where are the two people?Yes, they are in space, a place full of adventures and things we don't know.What's their job?They are astronauts.They wear special spacesuits and work in space.Look, what is this?Is this a plane?Of course not.It's a spacecraft.It can travel in space.What does it mean?Yes, it means 宇宙飞船.Please read after me.Spacecraft.Great.Now, please open your student's book.Turn to page 37.Read the text and think about the question.Is it a report, a poem, or an interview?Ready?Start.Time is up.Boys and girls, what kind of text is it?Bingo!It's a poem.How many verses can you find in this poem?We learned the word verse in unit 4.Do you still remember that?Yes, it means 诗节.So, take a quick look and see how many verses there are.Yes, there are five verses.Now, let's take a look at the title of the poem.What will you be?Who does you in the title refer to?Who asks the question, what will you be?Please take out your worksheet.Complete task 1.Read the poem and answer the questions.You will have one minute.Have you finished?Let's check.You got it.It refers to Ben.Look at the following four sentences in the poem.What will you be, Ben?What will you do, Ben?What will you see, Ben?Who will go with you, Ben?From these sentences, we can see someone is asking Ben some questions.So, the pronoun you in the questions refers to Ben, right?Then, who asks the question, what will you be?Yes, Kitty asks the question.How do you know that?Actually, we can find the answer in verse 4.Let's take a look.Who will go with you?You will go with me, Kitty.You will go with me.Have you noticed this is a dialogue between Kitty and Ben?Kitty asks Ben, who will go with him?And Ben tells Kitty, she will go with him.Are you clear now?Fantastic.Actually, the whole poem is a dialogue between Kitty and Ben.They are asking and answering questions about Ben's future job.Read the poem again and find all the questions Kitty asks.And write down a K before each question.How many questions does Kitty ask in the poem?She asks Ben five questions altogether, right?And when will we come back?Then, how does Ben answer these questions?Finish task two.Read the poem and fill in the blanks.Here is Kitty and Ben's dialogue.I'll be an astronaut like Zhai Zhigang.What will you do?I'll fly a spacecraft like him.What will you see?I'll see the stars.When will we come back?We will come back at night.Congratulations if you've got all the answers right.Now, boys and girls, what is repeated in each verse of the poem?Read the poem again and find out the answer.What is repeated in each verse of the poem?Kitty's question.That's right.How many times is each question asked?Read the poem again and find out.Yes, each question is asked twice.Now, please take out your worksheet.Look at task three.Read the poem again and answer the questions.Why does the writer repeat Kitty's question in each verse?How does Ben feel about his future job?Yes, you are right.Because the writer wants to show, Kitty is really interested in Ben's future job.Kitty shows great interest in Ben's future job.What about Ben himself?How does he feel about his future job?It's not an easy question.Don't worry.Let's find out the answer together.This is verse one.Shall we read it together?What does that here refer to?Yes, it refers to an astronaut like Zhai Zhigang.So, what does the sentence, that's what I'll be mean?You are right.It means good.You see, when Ben answers Kitty's question, he uses that's what I'll be to emphasize what he will be in the future.In verse two and three, we can also find such sentences.What does the sentence, that's what I'll do mean in verse two?Yes, it means,像 Zhai Zhigang一樣駕駛宇宙飛船,就是我將要做的事。What about, that's what I'll see in verse three?Very good.It means,星星是我將會看到的東西。So, in the above three verses, Ben uses that's blah blah to emphasize what he will be, what he will do, and what he will see.From these sentences, we can learn that Ben feels very excited about his future job, and he can't wait to be an astronaut.Now, since we have got a good understanding of the poem, let's read it after the recording with emotions.That is, when you are reading Kitty's questions, try to show your great interest in Ben's future job.And when you are reading Ben's answers, try to show the excitement.That's what I'll be.That's what I'll do.That's what I'll see.We'll come back at night.That's when we'll come back.Nice work!This time, please read with the recording, and imagine you are Kitty and Ben when you are reading the poem.I'll be an astronaut like Jiayi Jiegong.You'll go with me, Kitty.You'll go with me.When will we come back, Ben?You did a very good job.Now, it's your turn to have a try.Finish task four.Can you complete two more verses for the poem?Sounds fun!Let's start!Let me show you my student Jason's work.Shall we read his verses together?Where will you be, Ben?Where will you be?I'll be in space.That's where I'll be.How will you feel, Ben?How will you feel?I'll feel excited.That's how I'll feel.Fantastic, Jason!You use repetition to show Kitty's interest.And that's blah blah to show Ben's excitement.Great job!Boys and girls, your version may be better.Please share it with your classmates or read it to your parents if you like.Let's sum up.In today's lesson, you learned a very interesting poem about Ben's future job.What's more, you learned how to express your feelings in a poem by using repetition and emphasis.After class, please complete the exercises on your homework sheet.So much for today.See you next time.Thank you for watching.
